subject: Mathematics
prompt: Reflection property: ray from one focus reflects off ellipse and passes through?
explain: Optical property of ellipse: every ray from one focus reflects to pass through the other focus.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Number of normals that can be drawn from an external point to ellipse?
explain: At most 4 normals can be drawn from an external point to an ellipse.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: The eccentric angle φ relates point on ellipse to auxiliary circle how?
options: P=(cosφ, sinφ), Q=(a cosφ, b sinφ)
P=(b cosφ, a sinφ), Q=(a cosφ, b sinφ)
P=(a cosφ, b sinφ), Q=(b cosφ, b sinφ)
P=(a cosφ, b sinφ), Q=(a cosφ, a sinφ)
explain: Eccentric angle φ: ellipse point P=(a cosφ, b sinφ), auxiliary circle point Q has same x, y=a sinφ.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: For ellipse, product of perpendiculars from foci on any tangent is?
explain: Product of perpendiculars from two foci to any tangent of ellipse equals b².

subject: Mathematics
prompt: The locus of midpoints of focal chords of ellipse x²/a²+y²/b²=1 is?
explain: Locus of midpoints of focal chords is itself an ellipse.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: If e₁ and e₂ are eccentricities of an ellipse and its conjugate hyperbola, then?
explain: For ellipse & its conjugate hyperbola: 1/e₁² + 1/e₂² = 1.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Equation of ellipse with foci (±c, 0) and sum of focal distances = 2a is?
explain: With b²=a²−c², standard form is x²/a²+y²/b²=1 where b²=a²−c².

subject: Mathematics
prompt: If the ellipse x²/a² + y²/b² = 1 passes through (1,2) and (2,1), then?
options: a²≠b², it's an ellipse not a circle
explain: 1/a²+4/b²=1 and 4/a²+1/b²=1 give a²=b² only if symmetric — generally a≠b giving a true ellipse.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: The sum of squares of semi-axes of ellipse x²/a²+y²/b²=1 equals?
explain: Semi-axes are a and b; sum of squares is simply a²+b².

subject: Mathematics
prompt: For ellipse, the tangent at end of major axis is?
explain: At vertex (a,0), tangent is x=a, which is perpendicular to the major axis (x-axis).

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Tangent to x²/a²+y²/b²=1 at (a cosθ, b sinθ) meets axes; area of triangle formed?
explain: Triangle area = ½·(a/cosθ)·(b/sinθ) = ab/(2sinθcosθ) = 2ab/sin2θ.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: The point of intersection of tangents at ends of a latus rectum of x²/a²+y²/b²=1 (a>b) lies on?
explain: Tangents at ends of a latus rectum meet on the corresponding directrix x = a/e.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: For ellipse, max distance of point on ellipse from its centre is?
explain: The farthest points from centre are the vertices of major axis at distance a.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Equation of ellipse with centre (h,k), major axis parallel to x-axis, semi-axes a,b?
explain: Shifting origin to (h,k) gives the standard translated ellipse equation.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Sum of squares of conjugate semi-diameters of x²/a²+y²/b²=1 is always?
explain: For conjugate diameters OP and OQ: OP²+OQ² = a²+b² (constant).

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Area of parallelogram formed by tangents at ends of conjugate diameters of x²/a²+y²/b²=1?
explain: Area of parallelogram formed by tangents at conjugate diameter ends = 4ab (constant).

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Which form correctly gives the equation of ellipse with foci on y-axis (b>a)?
explain: When denominator under y² is larger (b>a), foci lie on y-axis at (0,±√(b²−a²)).

subject: Mathematics
prompt: The locus of foot of perpendicular from centre of x²/a²+y²/b²=1 on any tangent is?
explain: Locus of foot of perpendicular from origin to tangent is (x²+y²)² = a²x²+b²y².

subject: Mathematics
prompt: The number of tangents to ellipse x²/a²+y²/b²=1 from a point ON the ellipse?
explain: A point on the ellipse lies on the ellipse, so exactly one tangent exists at that point.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Tangent at vertex (a, 0) of ellipse x²/a²+y²/b²=1 is?
explain: At vertex (a,0): tangent is xx₁/a²+yy₁/b²=1 → x·a/a²=1 → x=a (vertical line).

subject: Mathematics
prompt: The line joining an end of major axis to an end of minor axis of x²/a²+y²/b²=1 has length?
explain: Distance from (a,0) to (0,b) = √(a²+b²).

subject: Mathematics
prompt: For ellipse, if e→0, its shape approaches?
explain: As e→0, a→b and b²/a²→1; the ellipse approaches a circle.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: For ellipse x²/a²+y²/b²=1, the equation of the chord joining (a cosα, b sinα) and (a cosβ, b sinβ) — its form?
explain: Chord eqn: x/a·cos((α+β)/2)+y/b·sin((α+β)/2) = cos((α−β)/2).

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Pole of line lx+my+n=0 w.r.t. x²/a²+y²/b²=1 is?
explain: Pole of lx+my+n=0 w.r.t. ellipse is (−a²l/n, −b²m/n).

subject: Mathematics
prompt: For ellipse x²/a²+y²/b²=1 (a>b), minimum distance from centre to ellipse is?
explain: The semi-minor axis b is the minimum distance from the centre to any point on the ellipse.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: For ellipse x²/a²+y²/b²=1 (a>b), the latus rectum is perpendicular to?
explain: The latus rectum passes through a focus and is perpendicular to the major axis.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: How many foci does a standard ellipse have?
explain: Every ellipse has exactly two foci symmetric about the centre.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: For x²/a²+y²/b²=1 (a>b), the ratio b²/a equals?
explain: The semi-latus rectum of an ellipse is b²/a = a(1−e²).

subject: Mathematics
prompt: For x²/a²+y²/b²=1, the eccentric angle of the end of the minor axis is?
explain: Minor axis ends are (0, ±b); parametrically (a cos90°, b sin90°) = (0,b), so θ=90°.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Orthoptic locus (director circle) of x²/a²+y²/b²=1 has radius?
explain: The director circle x²+y²=a²+b² has radius √(a²+b²).

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Ellipse x²/a²+y²/b²=1 (a>b): tangent at end of minor axis (0,b) is?
explain: Using tangent formula at (x₁,y₁): 0·x/a²+b·y/b²=1 → y=b.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: For x²/a²+y²/b²=1, the tangent at parametric point θ cuts x-axis at?
explain: Tangent: x cosθ/a + y sinθ/b=1; at y=0: x = a/cosθ = a secθ.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Eccentricity of a circle can be seen as a limiting ellipse with e =?
explain: A circle is the limiting case of an ellipse when e → 0 (both foci coincide at centre).

subject: Mathematics
prompt: For ellipse x²/a²+y²/b²=1 (a>b), which inequality defines the interior?
explain: A point (h,k) is inside the ellipse iff h²/a²+k²/b² < 1.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: For x²/a²+y²/b²=1 (a>b), the focal chord making angle 90° to major axis is?
explain: The latus rectum is a focal chord perpendicular to the major axis.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Which point on x²/a²+y²/b²=1 (a>b) is farthest from focus S(ae, 0)?
explain: Max distance from focus S(ae,0) is a+ae = a(1+e), achieved at (−a, 0).

subject: Mathematics
prompt: For x²/a²+y²/b²=1 (a>b), the area of triangle formed by normal at (x₁,y₁) and axes is?
explain: Normal at (x₁,y₁) cuts axes; using intercepts gives area = (a²−b²)²|x₁y₁|/(2a²b²).

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Number of tangents from a point ON the ellipse x²/a²+y²/b²=1?
explain: A point on the ellipse yields exactly one tangent (it is the point of tangency).

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Eccentricity of a circle viewed as limiting ellipse is?
explain: A circle is an ellipse with a=b, so c=0 and e=c/a=0.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Sum of squares of conjugate semi-diameters (r₁²+r₂²) of x²/a²+y²/b²=1 is?
explain: For conjugate semi-diameters r₁ and r₂, r₁²+r₂²=a²+b² (constant).

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Locus of foot of perpendicular from centre of x²/a²+y²/b²=1 to any tangent is?
explain: The locus is the auxiliary ellipse (x²+y²)²=a²x²+b²y², called the pedal curve.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Point on x²/a²+y²/b²=1 (a>b) farthest from focus S(ae,0) is?
explain: Max focal distance = a+ae=a(1+e), attained at vertex (−a,0) opposite to S.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: For x²/a²+y²/b²=1 (a>b), the centre is at?
explain: The standard ellipse is centred at the origin (0,0).

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Equation of ellipse with focus (0,±c) and sum of focal distances 2b (b>a)?
explain: Foci on y-axis means b>a; standard form is x²/a²+y²/b²=1 with b>a.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: For x²/a²+y²/b²=1 (a>b), the tangent at end of minor axis (0, b) is?
explain: Tangent at (0,b): x·0/a²+y·b/b²=1 → y=b, a horizontal line.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: For x²/a²+y²/b²=1 (a>b), eccentric angle of end of minor axis (0, b) is?
explain: At (0,b): cosθ=0, sinθ=1, so θ=π/2.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: For x²/a²+y²/b²=1, the tangent at θ cuts x-axis at?
explain: Set y=0: x cosθ/a=1 → x=a/cosθ=a secθ.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: For x²/a²+y²/b²=1 (a>b), the latus rectum is perpendicular to?
explain: The latus rectum passes through a focus and is perpendicular to the major axis.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: For ellipse, if e→1, its shape approaches?
explain: As e→1 the ellipse flattens and degenerately approaches a parabola.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Sum of squares of conjugate semi-diameters r₁, r₂ of x²/a²+y²/b²=1 is?
explain: For any pair of conjugate semi-diameters, r₁²+r₂²=a²+b² (constant).

subject: Mathematics
prompt: For ellipse x²/a²+y²/b²=1 (a>b), tangent at any point makes equal angles with?
explain: Reflection property: tangent at P makes equal angles with the two focal radii SP and S'P.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: For ellipse x²/a²+y²/b²=1 (a>b), the auxiliary circle has radius?
explain: Auxiliary circle is x²+y²=a², radius = semi-major axis a.
